in_marathi.name: Neharika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neharika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Neharika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘neha’ which means new or fresh. This name is often given to a baby girl born in the new year or during the spring season.
